title: Web need: show each clip's DAW file name and download one clip's .alc
description:
## Need (for the web/docs session; not visuals)
In the Library's clip list a person should see the file name a clip gets in the DAW (so they can find it in the DAW's browser) and be able to export one clip's `.alc` on its own (for example to drag it straight from the web app).

## Data the UI needs
- `apricity-daw::names::clip_file_name` exposed to the browser through `crates/apricity-web` (a small pure wasm export, like the existing compiler exports), or returned by the sidecar-status endpoint from the M2 web need.
- A download of one clip's `.alc` bytes (from `apricity serve`).

## Out of scope
Visual design.

## Verify
`node web/test/wasm.test.mjs` gains a check that the wasm export returns the same names as the Rust unit tests.
